character: A ski-in/ski-out alpine village in Victoria's Alpine National Park above Mount Beauty, owned by Vail Resorts and included without day limits on the Epic Pass. The village sits on the mountain, and cross-country trails extend onto the Bogong High Plains.
learning: Reference note: ski school and beginner areas are in the village; confirm 2027 lesson products and prices.

source.note: Winter 2026: lifts closed Sun 6 Sep 2026, an early close (SnowBrains; shared research notes). Opening: operating from opening weekend Sat 6 Jun 2026 with the Mouse Trap carpet and the Halley's Comet chairlift (https://snowbrains.com/australia-ski-season-2026-opening-weekend-perisher-thredbo-buller-falls-hotham/).

season.typicalText: The season traditionally starts on the King's Birthday long weekend in early June (6 Jun 2026); in the very poor 2026 season the lifts closed on 6 Sep.
season.notes: Southern Hemisphere: Piste season id 2026-27 is the June–October 2027 winter (the one the 2026-27 Ikon and Epic passes cover); 2025-26 is the 2026 winter and 2024-25 the 2025 winter. No 2027 opening or closing date was found as of 2026-09-30. Australian resorts traditionally open on the King's Birthday long weekend — in 2027 that is Sat 12 – Mon 14 June (calendar inference, not an announcement). Victorian alpine resorts also charge a resort entry fee (a Falls Creek entry-price cut was reported by https://www.snowsbest.com/resort-entry-falls-creek/).

prices.note: Main-season adult day price per the search summary; the season was not stated (most likely the 2026 winter). Snowstash lists 2026 Falls Creek lift passes at A$97–A$221 (product mix not stated), so treat this as indicative. Date-based pricing applies online.
